def VTask.memPartition : {α : Type u_1} -> (f : ℕ → Set α) -> ℕ → Set (Set α)
  := fun {α} f n => 
    let rec memPartitionAux : ℕ → Set (Set α) := fun n =>
      if hn : n = 0 then
        {Set.univ}
      else
        let m : ℕ := n - 1
        let memPartitionAtM : Set (Set α) := memPartitionAux m
        (memPartitionAtM.bind (fun s =>
          {s ∩ f m, s \ f m}))
    memPartitionAux n
